phase: Phase 5 — z_ecg representation and causal-role audit
scope: Representation/provenance/temporal-role audit only; no causal discovery, DAG, treatment selection, or effect estimation.

phase5_input_audit.evidence: Local VAE documentation describes 12-lead raw waveform input and a Conv1D beta-VAE; VAE implementation and waveform files are absent.
Documentation specifies layer widths, kernels, strides, activations, and 82,448,332 parameters; no model source/checkpoint is present to verify exact implementation or padding.
The master parquet schema contains 64 columns from z_ecg_1 through z_ecg_64.
Documentation says the deterministic encoder mean mu is saved; extraction source is absent.
Documentation describes encoder-only extraction with a best checkpoint reported as epoch 109; extraction code and run artifacts are absent.
Documentation identifies study_id; the master has unique study_id rows and all 64 dimensions, but the source embedding join cannot be reconstructed locally.

Documentation reports 12 leads x 5000 samples at 500 Hz and WFDB/HDF5 conversion, but local dataset/conversion code and waveform arrays are absent; filtering, normalization, resampling, and learned parameters cannot be checked.
Documentation depicts raw waveforms as VAE input and discusses engineered ECG features separately; no source code establishes the exact waveform-to-model transform.
Master parquet split sizes and labels are directly inspectable; VAE documentation label counts disagree with current validation/test parquet counts, and training code/logs are absent.
SubjectID sets in the actual master train/validation/test files are disjoint; actual VAE loader membership is not verifiable.
Documentation names a checkpoint run and best epoch 109, but the checkpoint and extraction run metadata are absent, so its use for these embeddings is unverified.
No VAE training code, logs, split manifests, or checkpoint metadata are locally present.
Documentation describes validation loss/checkpoint selection and a separate test split, but absent training source/logs prevent confirmation of gradient or model-selection use.
Documentation says MI_Post-Incident was excluded, but actual training membership and waveform-to-label map are absent; master dataset itself has no MI_Post-Incident label category.
No preprocessing code or fitted parameter artifacts are present to establish fit partition or validation/test influence.

NOT VERIFIED — documentation describes the VAE as unsupervised, but the training/dataloader source is unavailable; use of labels, treatment, diagnosis, or downstream event information cannot be confirmed.

document_claims.input_source: MIMIC-IV-ECG v1.0 WFDB files, later HDF5

provenance.documentation_epoch_discrepancy: The documentation reports best checkpoint epoch 109 and training stopping at epoch 129; its overview also says 109 epochs trained. Without run files, the actual selected checkpoint and completed epoch count cannot be independently confirmed.
provenance.limitation: Documentation is treated as documentary evidence, not as verification of the execution history or identity of the embeddings in the current parquet files.

waveform_embedding_study_id_linkage.linkage_interpretation: The master rows can be checked for study_id uniqueness and complete z_ecg columns. The standalone embedding table, waveform archive, and join code are absent locally, so equality of the source waveform and the waveform represented by each master row cannot be independently re-performed.

latent_diagnostics.interpretation: Diagnostics describe the current master embeddings only; they do not establish semantic meanings, independent causal variables, or justify deleting dimensions.

A_first_ecg_admission.why: The selection rule does not supply an exact medication assignment time; even Rule A's earliest ECG and Rules B/C's pre-MI ECGs cannot establish pre-treatment ordering.

B_first_ecg_before_MI.why: The selection rule does not supply an exact medication assignment time; even Rule A's earliest ECG and Rules B/C's pre-MI ECGs cannot establish pre-treatment ordering.

C_closest_ecg_before_MI.why: The selection rule does not supply an exact medication assignment time; even Rule A's earliest ECG and Rules B/C's pre-MI ECGs cannot establish pre-treatment ordering.

treatment_temporal_eligibility.note: The master schema has window-coded treatment indicators, not exact medication administration/assignment timestamps. Earliest ecg_time does not resolve ordering.

A_first_ecg_admission.treatment_specific_baseline_compatibilit: UNRESOLVED; even earliest ECG is not proven before treatment assignment
A_first_ecg_admission.causal_discovery_use: PROVISIONAL / CANDIDATE REPRESENTATION ONLY; not final causal baseline

B_first_ecg_before_MI.treatment_specific_baseline_compatibilit: Not established; MI/outcome-time-dependent selection and exact treatment timing unavailable
B_first_ecg_before_MI.causal_discovery_use: PROVISIONAL / CANDIDATE REPRESENTATION ONLY; not final causal baseline

C_closest_ecg_before_MI.treatment_specific_baseline_compatibilit: Not established; MI/outcome-time-dependent selection and exact treatment timing unavailable
C_closest_ecg_before_MI.causal_discovery_use: PROVISIONAL / CANDIDATE REPRESENTATION ONLY; not final causal baseline

D_first_clinically_eligible.treatment_specific_baseline_compatibilit: BLOCKED — no prespecified clinical eligibility criterion or exact treatment timing.
D_first_clinically_eligible.causal_discovery_use: Not constructable from current data without inventing clinical eligibility criteria.

B_vs_C_selected_study_id_comparison.interpretation: Identical eligible counts do not imply identical ECG selection; both rules remain outcome/time-dependent candidates.

temporal_eligibility_and_mi_timing.interpretation: An ECG timestamp before index_mi_time, where measurable, establishes only temporal ordering before that recorded MI timestamp. It does not establish ordering before treatment assignment. MI-relative Rules B/C are outcome/time-dependent selections.

causal_role_analysis.mechanism: A pre-treatment ECG state may influence treatment assignment and subsequent MI risk.
causal_role_analysis.temporal_requirement: The ECG measurement must precede treatment assignment and outcome; the relevant state must be a cause of both treatment and outcome.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_available: ECG representations and admission-level treatment indicators are present; exact treatment times are not.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_missing: Treatment-specific time zero, waveform provenance, pre-treatment ordering, and evidence linking ECG state to treatment assignment and outcome.
causal_role_analysis.causal_implication: Could be a confounder only if those conditions are established; currently not established.

causal_role_analysis.role: B — Proxy for latent cardiovascular state
causal_role_analysis.mechanism: The embedding may summarize ECG morphology that reflects an underlying physiological or disease state.
causal_role_analysis.temporal_requirement: The represented ECG state must be measured at the relevant pre-treatment baseline to proxy a baseline state.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_available: The documentation describes a morphology-reconstruction VAE; the master contains 64 embedding values.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_missing: Verified waveform/checkpoint lineage, latent construct validity, and pre-treatment timing.
causal_role_analysis.causal_implication: Observed z_ecg is not identical to the unobserved physiological state and cannot be assumed to block confounding.

causal_role_analysis.mechanism: ECG morphology could be prognostic for MI without affecting treatment assignment.
causal_role_analysis.temporal_requirement: For baseline prediction/adjustment, z_ecg must be available before treatment and outcome.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_available: MI labels and embeddings coexist in the master data; Phase 5 does not estimate predictive performance or causal influence.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_missing: Independent predictive validation and evidence about the treatment-assignment mechanism.
causal_role_analysis.causal_implication: Prognostic association alone would not make z_ecg a confounder.

causal_role_analysis.mechanism: Treatment or treatment-induced physiology could change a subsequent ECG that then relates to outcome.
causal_role_analysis.temporal_requirement: Treatment precedes the ECG, and that ECG precedes the outcome.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_available: Treatment indicators are window-coded and lack exact administration times; multiple ECGs may occur within admission.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_missing: Treatment time, selected ECG time relative to treatment, and outcome timing.
causal_role_analysis.causal_implication: Adjustment could block part of an effect if z_ecg is post-treatment; that ordering is unresolved.

causal_role_analysis.mechanism: Treatment and another acute process may both affect the ECG measurement/embedding.
causal_role_analysis.temporal_requirement: Both causes precede the measured ECG and the analysis conditions on z_ecg.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_available: The dataset has acute-treatment indicators and ECG representations, but no validated causal ordering.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_missing: Treatment timing, acute-process measures, and a treatment-specific time zero.
causal_role_analysis.causal_implication: Conditioning could induce bias under this structure; it cannot currently be ruled out.

causal_role_analysis.mechanism: Baseline ECG morphology could mark strata with different treatment response.
causal_role_analysis.temporal_requirement: The modifier must be defined before treatment assignment.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_available: Sixty-four dimensions exist, but no treatment-effect analysis is permitted or performed in Phase 5.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_missing: Pre-treatment timing and treatment-specific causal estimand/effect-modification evidence.
causal_role_analysis.causal_implication: Possible in principle; neither supported nor excluded by current audit evidence.

causal_role_analysis.mechanism: The block may encode waveform patterns useful for prediction without a justified causal adjustment role.
causal_role_analysis.temporal_requirement: Prediction use still requires a deployment-appropriate observation time; causal baseline use requires pre-treatment timing.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_available: A learned ECG representation is present; no Phase 5 predictive model is fit.
causal_role_analysis.evidence_missing: Validated prediction utility, provenance, and temporal eligibility.
causal_role_analysis.causal_implication: Predictive utility, if later shown, would not establish confounding or adjustment suitability.

representation_options.advantages: Retains the available learned representation without arbitrary compression.
representation_options.risks_or_requirements: Higher-dimensional discovery, correlation/instability, limited interpretability, and unresolved provenance/timing.
representation_options.phase5_assessment: Carry as a quarantined optional block only; no approved causal feature matrix.

representation_options.advantages: Could reduce dimensionality for a later specified workflow.
representation_options.risks_or_requirements: Requires an explicit objective, training-only fit, documented explained variance, and downstream stability checks; no outcome/treatment-driven component selection.
representation_options.phase5_assessment: Not performed; no evidence currently justifies selecting components or fitting PCA.

representation_options.advantages: Could reduce variables if stable relationships to ECG properties are established.
representation_options.risks_or_requirements: Would require validated, stable, interpretable mapping; individual latent dimensions have no supplied semantic labels.
representation_options.phase5_assessment: Not recommended on current evidence; do not invent dimension meanings.

representation_options.advantages: Preserves the 64-vector as one ECG representation family and avoids treating each dimension as a separately meaningful causal node.
representation_options.risks_or_requirements: A block label does not resolve temporal eligibility, leakage, or whether a later method can handle a multivariate block.
representation_options.phase5_assessment: Most defensible provisional schema representation for later review; still quarantined and not approved for discovery or adjustment.

recommendation.discovery: NO FINAL REPRESENTATION DECISION YET. Keep all 64 dimensions identified as one quarantined z_ecg block in the schema; do not use the block as a causal discovery input until provenance and the target treatment-specific time zero are established.
recommendation.later_treatment_effect_modeling: Do not include z_ecg as a baseline adjustment variable unless the selected ECG is shown to precede that treatment's assignment and outcome, and the representation's training/preprocessing provenance is verified. A post-treatment ECG could be a mediator or collider.

phase6_handoff: Obtain VAE model/training/extraction source, full training logs, split manifests, configuration, and the exact checkpoint used to generate current embeddings.
Obtain the waveform/HDF5 archive and study_id mapping; reproduce waveform-to-embedding joins and verify each embedding matches the corresponding master ECG.
Verify actual VAE train/validation/test membership, subject-level isolation, optimizer exposure to validation/test data, and whether post-MI waveforms entered optimization.
Recover waveform preprocessing code and fitted parameters; identify fit partitions and any validation/test influence.
Verify whether labels, diagnoses, outcomes, or treatment information entered training, selection, or extraction.
For the eventual treatment-specific question, obtain exact medication assignment/administration times and define a treatment-specific causal baseline before evaluating ECG eligibility.
Keep outcome-relative ECG selection separate from treatment-relative baseline eligibility; do not use time_diff_hours as a universal MI clock.
